description: Synthetic, balanced, action-shaped semantic calibration suite with 1,024 generated cases derived from 32 seed scenarios.
label_definition: expected_flag means the semantic advisory should recommend review; it is not an allow/deny or policy authorization label.
generation: Deterministic combinations of seed scenarios, target paths, and context wording. The 1,024 rows are correlated variants, not 1,024 independent real-world observations.
limitations: Synthetic examples do not represent production traffic or establish real-world accuracy.
The set is deliberately balanced and does not represent operational risk prevalence.
Rows sharing a family are correlated; hold out entire seed families for evaluation rather than randomly splitting rows.
Have domain owners review labels and add privacy-safe representative requests before choosing a production threshold.
Each text value matches the current semantic_engine._request_text serialization.
